utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday works for me — I’ll bring gloves, a flashlight, and a few basic tools. I’ll start by the mailboxes and go down the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep repeating the plan as folks check in. Jules is still connecting people who want to help, and once Nell confirms the details, Jules will send them to Hana.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — Saturday it is. I’ll stick to the mailboxes first and work down the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center. If you’ve got any fixes, bring them to my porch or leave a note at the community board.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — I can work around the school schedule for Sunday. I’ll let Leo and Opal know too in case anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — I appreciate you spreading the word. If Leo or Opal have any repair requests, they can leave a note at the community board or stop by my porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I sorted the donated screws and checked the tape inventory for the repair drive. I can check the repair drive time and let Faye know right away since she can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren. I’ll sort the donated tools and label the boxes at Leo’s place this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll check the repair drive time and tell Faye right away. Thanks, Sam — that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Dane can help this afternoon, and I can spread the word too. Once the date, time, and meeting spot are set, I’ll send Hana the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Saturday works for me. Just tell me the time and meeting spot when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll send Hana the time and meeting spot as soon as they’re confirmed. Saturday sounds good, and I’ll keep helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can send Noah the time and location for Saturday’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, and Pia already has the timing and pickup details too. I’m out running errands, so I’ll keep an ear out for anything else that needs help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep you posted if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—Cleo’s on the list, and Tess plans to come too. I’m still spreading the word, so I’ll make sure Nell knows as well.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll sort the rest and send the time and place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—send me the time and place, and I’ll keep passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with the repair drive this afternoon. Once Eli sends the list to Ira, I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Once the list goes out, I’ll make sure Rosa has the sign-up details too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — once Eli sends it, I’ll check what’s left and help this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Quinn’s going to fill me in first, so I’m ready. I’m happy to come by for the repair drive once I know the time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll help spread the word too, once I hear the time. Rosa’s taking requests at her porch or the community board and sorting them by urgency.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect — once Quinn tells me the time, I’ll swing by and help out. Good on Rosa for keeping the requests organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I’ll check who still needs repairs and help spread the word. Let me know when Ira has Eli’s list, and I’ll compare it with what we already have.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a few tools ready to lend, and I’ll match them up with Eli’s repair list once it’s in. If you hear the time and place from Leo, let me know and I’ll bring what we need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—I’ll keep an eye out for Leo’s time and place and pass it along. Once Ira has Eli’s list, send it my way and I’ll help line it up with what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll make a clear list of what’s left and send it to Ira, then I’ll pass Dane the rest this afternoon so it all gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — please send me the repair drive date, time, and meeting spot once they’re confirmed. Then I can help share the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — once the date, time, and meeting spot are confirmed, I’ll send them your way right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks for bringing supplies, Cleo. I can check in with Mina about who still needs repairs, and I can help with tools and hands on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Glad to help, Rey. I’ll bring the supplies over and keep an eye out for anything else we run short on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Cleo. I’ll talk to Mina and make sure we’re set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll head straight over as soon as the location is confirmed. Just let me know when Faye spots it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the timing and pickup details with Pia? I want to make sure we have them right for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check with Pia, but I still need the repair drive location first. Once Faye spots it, I’ll head over right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday works for me. I can help with tools and steady hands, and I’ll check in with Mina about who still needs repairs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word and repeat the plan to the neighbors. Sounds like Saturday’s a good start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll talk with Mina and make sure we know who still needs repairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday works for me. I’ll bring gloves, a flashlight, and a few basic tools, and I’ll help start by the mailboxes and work down the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I can help this afternoon with whatever’s left. Once Leo sends the time and place, I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll watch for Leo’s time and place, then we can meet up Saturday and get started by the mailboxes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the repair drive timing and pickup details with Pia? I just want to make sure I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah — it’s on Saturday, and I’ll check with Pia about the pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — please confirm the pickup details with Pia too, so I know we’ve got both parts right.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help once we’ve confirmed the timing and pickup details, and I know what supplies are already on hand. If you want, I can also help organize the list after that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Pia — once the repair drive location is confirmed, I’ll head straight over. Let me know as soon as Faye spots it, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — once Faye confirms the location, please send me the timing and pickup details too, and I’ll help with the list after we know what supplies we already have.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’m out running errands, so I’ll keep an ear out and wait for Eli’s list. If anything else comes up for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll sort the donated tools and set aside anything we can lend out, then label the boxes at Leo’s place this afternoon. If Eli’s list comes in, I’ll make sure it’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out and about, and I’ll watch for Eli’s list too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I brought a few supplies for the repair drive, so we should be set for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Cleo—thank you. I’ll add them to the Sunday repair drive at the community center and make sure they’re set with the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Glad to help, Rosa. I’ll keep an eye out in case we need anything else before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — send me the repair drive date, time, and meeting spot once you’ve confirmed them. I can help spread the word and connect anyone who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m confirming the date, time, and meeting spot now, and I’ll send them over as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — I’ll wait for the confirmed date, time, and meeting spot. Once you send them, I can help spread the word and connect anyone who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive. Rosa’s gathering requests at her porch or the community board, and I’ll pass that along to folks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Nell. I’ve got a few tools ready to lend, and I’m matching them up with the repair list so we know where they’ll help most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll keep telling neighbors to drop requests with Rosa at her porch or the community board, and I’ll spread the word about the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can spread the word and connect folks who want to pitch in. Once we lock the date, time, and meeting spot, I’ll send Hana the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Jules. I’ll send Dane the list of what’s left and get it sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep folks posted, and once you confirm the details, I’ll pass them along to Hana too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard Sam’s heading over to label the boxes at your place this afternoon, and Oren already sorted the donated screws and checked the tape inventory. I’ll keep my ears open for any new repair drive updates and let Eli know if I hear something.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess. I’ll sort the rest and send the time and place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Leo — I’m happy to come by and help if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—once you confirm the repair drive time, I’ll work around the school schedule. Just let me know as soon as you have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll check the repair drive time right now and tell you as soon as I have it. I’m also sorting the screws and tape, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep the school schedule flexible and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s on Saturday — I can send Noah the time and location if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—please send Noah the time and location. I can check who still needs repairs and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send Noah the time and location now, and thanks for checking who still needs repairs.
